A cobblestone pathway terminates at two granite steps that lead up to a covered porch on the south face of the two story brown brick building with white trimming. The hedges which bound the open grassy fields on both sides of the orphanage extend to the back of the building. On the east side of the building a dark twisting tree with no leaves extends four snaking arms in roughly each of the ordinal directions. The tree doesn't provide very much shade at the tips, but young children can be seen from time to time chasing each other around the base of the tree in complete shade. Occasionally, adolescent Zacotl and Fae can be seen chasing each other while deftly flying between the branches. On the south side of the building the granite porch extends for three quarters of the building and meets a portion of the building which juts out to terminate the porch. The porch's roof is supported by five large white Doric columns that terminate just outside the bounds of the granite porch. The portion of the building which meets the porch is surrounded by massive windows surrounded by white plaster on both the South and East aspect. The building projects itself further laterally and vertically than it seems to at a distance. The roof of the building is two large peaks and one smaller peak that covers the corner portion of the building. The roof itself is made of red ceramic tiles and two large brick chimneys extend themselves in transverse orientation on the east and west side of the building. There are children playing outside the orphanage and a flattened baseline of conglomerated noises which emanates from inside the building itself.

[Urda Town Square Center]
On this site, a fierce battle for control of the great city was waged, and on this site is where its citizens now celebrate that victory. Statues of the fallen heroes, and great leaders of the alliance adorn the tops of grand marble archways that scatter over the square. They stand ever vigilant against any unseen enemy. The people of Urda flock here to barter and trade, to converse with friends, or just relax near the fountain and have a game of chess. Benches and tables dot the landscape near the edge of the fountain. Hawkers of all type roll through this area with their wares, hoping to make a few coins. The many languages of races and guilds reverberate off the storefronts of the surrounding Merchant Square where a constant foot traffic ebbs and flows, making this the heart of the city.

[Cathedral Altar]
A thin red carpet covers a series of stone steps leading up to a large altar. The once white marble of the altar is now stained with rusty blood. The floor is jagged and treacherous, one wrong step and it could end a life. The walls are rocky and uneven, and thin streams of acidic water run down the stone, slowly eating away at the rock with loud hissing pops. Whatever is perverting the cathedral on the surface certainly makes its lair right here.

[Sanctuary of Eyridane and Morana]
The small path ends as the trees part, revealing a small clearing. Sunlight filters down from above, splashing the vibrant green grass and wildflowers. The noise of the central part of the grove all but fades away in this quiet sanctuary. An altar of stone rests in the center of the small clearing of verdant grass. Tangled vines have grown wild across the hard stone and though no markings can be seen, it is obvious that this is a place sacred to the twin goddesses of nature. Overhead the soft warbling of songbirds blends with the chirping crickets below into a sublime symphony of sounds. Small trinkets of adoration and worship have been left at the base of the altar, each one a symbol of devotion to their beloved gods.
